title: Deals
hint: Log every deal with its date and amount. Each deal is added to the agent’s quarter total automatically.
celebrateNote: A celebration appears on every screen right away when the deal is in the current quarter. A deal dated in an earlier quarter counts in its numbers without a celebration.
addedCelebrated: Added a {amount} deal for {name} — {quarter} total is now {total}. The celebration is on the screens 🎉
addedQuiet: Added a {amount} deal for {name} — {quarter} total is now {total}. (Earlier quarter, so no celebration)
confirmDelete: Delete the {amount} deal for {name}? The amount will be removed from the quarter total.
deleted: Deleted the {amount} deal for {name} and removed it from the total.
search: Search by consultant, team, developer or project
agentSearch: Type a consultant's name to search
teamDiffers: This deal will be recorded for a team other than the consultant's current one, and will count toward the team you picked.
shareRule: The share must be between 1 and 99.
confirmDeleteShared: This is a shared deal. Deleting it removes both shares and deducts each from that consultant’s total. Delete the share of {name} ({amount}) and the partner’s share?
addedSharedCelebrated: Added a shared {amount} deal in {quarter}: {name} {first} and {partner} {second}. The celebration is on the screens 🎉
addedSharedQuiet: Added a shared {amount} deal in {quarter}: {name} {first} and {partner} {second}. (Past quarter, so no celebration)
editNote: Editing corrects the consultant and team totals for the quarter right away, with no celebration on the screens.
updated: Deal updated: {amount} for {name}. Totals have been refreshed.
totalHint: Sets a consultant’s total sales for a whole quarter. The difference from their recorded deals counts as unitemized sales. The total can’t go below the recorded deals, and no celebration is shown on the screens.
totalTooLow: The total can’t be less than the recorded deals ({sum}). Edit the deals themselves to lower it.
